pages.purpose: Nav shell, mobile menu, quick links, search modal, account nav, cart button, footer and social links, action bar.

page_notes.content: The header (components/nav/index.tsx) is an async Server Component that loads the Shopify menu with handle main-menu through getMenu in lib/menu/server.ts (cached remotely, tag menus). If the menu is empty or the fetch fails it falls back to a single Shop link to /collections/all. The same items feed MobileMenu (accordion drawer) and QuickLinks (desktop mega-menu: second-level items become columns, up to 5, and third-level items become the links under each column). Footer menu items are still hardcoded to an empty array in components/footer/index.tsx.
